kind: Gazette of India notification (draft) + later amendment
title: MoEFCC S.O. 229(E), 22 Jan 2016: draft notification declaring the Eco-sensitive Zone around Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Maharashtra (F. No. 25/47/2014-ESZ-RE); amendment S.O. 4004(E), 5 Nov 2020 to final S.O. 3645(E) of 5 Dec 2016
creator: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
